notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.content: [p]Hi everybody. I've updated the Demo one last time, before it's time to lock things down for a while. This version of the Demo has a number of changes:[/p][olist][*][p]It's now a [i]lot[/i] faster to get into the gameplay. One quick (skippable) cutscene. Apparently, the previous version might have taken too long for the players who just wanted to get straight into the action, so I've made this change to see if that can entice more of you to give this a go long enough to play it a bit![/p][/*][*][p]There are a bunch of new weapons and other things. I'm not going to spoil all of that here, but several of them can be crafted during the Demo. Have fun![/p][/*][*][p]Minor tweaks to a few features. The Demo's pretty stable at this point, but there is always room for improvement.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This will [i]probably[/i] be the last Demo update. I wish it wasn't so, but I'm on the downward slope to complete the game, and I probably can't spare more time to tweak the Demo for the next month or two. If you'd care to leave any feedback about your experience with the Demo, I'd appreciate it, as it helps me improve the game and it helps a bit with Steam's algo.[/p][previewyoutube="lNcqS_BizqA;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: It's now a [i]lot[/i] faster to get into the gameplay. One quick (skippable) cutscene. Apparently, the previous version might have taken too long for the players who just wanted to get straight into the action, so I've made this change to see if that can entice more of you to give this a go long enough to play it a bit!
There are a bunch of new weapons and other things. I'm not going to spoil all of that here, but several of them can be crafted during the Demo. Have fun!

tags.balance_change: Minor tweaks to a few features. The Demo's pretty stable at this point, but there is always room for improvement.

notes.title: Demo 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everybody. The Demo's been out for a week now, looks like a fair number of folks have put it into their Library, and I've gotten a couple of comments thus far, both super-helpful! 

The Demo's codebase was nearly a month behind the full game, so I've taken the time to update it and release a new build to try.

Features:

1. Better UI explanations of weapons, with some in-depth information about how they work. Better UI support for "which key do I hit to select my weapon", etc.; it should be a lot more intuitive to understand Dual-Wielding.

2. The Flashlight is standard gear (again). This is a starting item that I've gone back and forth about, largely because internal playtesters didn't appear to be using it. Also, don't forget that you can use Nightvision at the same time you're using 

3. There are a few new weapons and Gadgets to play with, including the ability to build a Tachyon Injector, which gives you several seconds of Slow Time. It's a really cool mechanic, and the current version is probably OP, but whatever, it's the Demo, have some fun!

4. A bunch of boring optimizations for things like the trail system, so that cool explosions and other events don't drag down your FPS much.

Here's a gameplay video where I'm testing out one of the game-modes, and I'll talk a bit more about the Thermoptic Camoflauge system and a few other things.

[previewyoutube=oO0c6bEoTaE;full][/previewyoutube]
